description: Create a token transfer proposal from a smart account. Specify amount in human-readable units (e.g. '100' for 100 USDC). Returns the proposal with gas estimates.

account.description: The smart account address to create the proposal from (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars)

amount.description: The amount of --token the recipient receives, in human-readable units (e.g., '100' for 100 USDC, '0.5' for 0.5 ETH). With --source-token, the account spends whatever amount of it that costs

chainId.description: The chain ID where the recipient receives the token (e.g., 1 for Ethereum, 8453 for Base)

memo.description: Optional memo for the transaction (max 500 chars)

name.description: Optional name for the proposal. If omitted, auto-generated from transfer details

properties.description: Optional custom JSON metadata. Total minified ≤ 500 chars. Used as the base; any --property overlays are applied on top. To load from a file, use shell substitution: --properties "$(cat props.json)"

property.description: String key/value overlays for properties; repeatable. Splits on the first '='. Example: --property invoice=INV-42

recipient.description: The recipient address for the transfer (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars, cannot be zero address)

sourceChainId.description: Optional chain of --source-token. Defaults to --chain-id. A different chain bridges the payment to --chain-id

sourceToken.description: Optional token to pay with, like "Pay with" in the web app. Defaults to --token, a direct transfer. Any other token the account holds is swapped, or bridged when --source-chain-id differs. An Earn token pays from that Earn position

token.description: The token the recipient receives. An Earn token address sends the Earn position itself and is allowed only to accounts in this workspace. To pay with a different token, such as from Earn, pass it as --source-token

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: transactions_create_transfer
